notes: Coverage: the whole image was opened once for layout, then half_a and half_b once each in order. Every text block and every inline/display formula, including agreed witness wording, was compared against both C and H. This includes all word endings, accents, punctuation, quotations, underlines, capitals, indices, stars, arrows, parentheses, the cancellation, and the resolution annotation. This is a visual-transcription coverage statement, not a mathematical proof check.

The whole and halves were not reopened. Each of the 16 retained crops was created once and viewed once. c16 addresses the punctuation after sur Y that was explicitly left open in the half_a review but accidentally omitted from the initial crop-plan list; its addition did not involve any image re-view. The supplied half_b begins at whole-image y786. All reported approximate half-settled boxes use whole-image coordinates remembered from the single half view.

The page asks whether relative cohomology can be defined functorially in an abelian sheaf F, or a complex of such sheaves, for a morphism of toposes. It names a functor between the indicated derived categories. Its own geometric interpretation in terms of n-champs de Picard, with n described as grand, suggests existence. These are statements and tentative words on the page; no external equivalence or definition has been added.

The author says only that he sees an evident construction by hand in two extreme cases. This scan contains case a) only. It gives the (-1)-acyclic condition, the parenthetic slice example and the reference plus haut, then a displayed construction involving Coker, an indicated injective resolution and the shift [-1]. No proof of the claim, exactness, functoriality or resolution independence was attempted in this reading run.

The handwritten text is one unnamed dark-pen hand or layer. The packet and this page alone do not independently establish a personal hand attribution. The archive pencil number is separately inventoried. There is no title, date, author page number, stated total page count, signature, diagram or non-diagram drawing on the page.

The two R signs have internal uprights and are rendered mathbb. Ab is rendered mathit as an approximation to the observed oblique ordinary letters; that typographic comparison is less certain than the actual letter identities. The recurring morphism sign is reserved as g/q at its first occurrence only, and later identical signs follow the first candidate as required.

The final formula was not regularized. Its opening after g_* remains square/round uncertain while the visible closes are round. The resolution glyph remains e/C uncertain. The underbrace reaches the first close after F and not the next close; C stops its underbrace earlier. The index of Gamma is cancelled, and the cancellation is preserved rather than printing H’s live Y.

H’s quoted résol. inj. annotation is credited as preserved content in its note; the difference concerns the missing brace/exact attachment. Its comment that the Gamma index is empâté is descriptive rather than an explicit uncertainty flag. The only explicit H reading doubt on this page is plus haut, which is resolved here.

H’s editorial archive-order discussion is not ink on this sheet and is not imported into reading.tex. Its page{12} metadata matches the pencil archive number, so no artificial omission row is generated for that number. No earlier or later page, other reader return, OCR, recognition service, PDF text layer or outside source was used.

Two detached lower-left dark points and a point at the opening quote are preserved with phantom alternatives for uncertain independent textual status. No punctuation meaning is inferred from their mere existence. After exister and after the final NB parenthesis, no separate full-stop stroke survives; the reading does not supply one from syntax.

The underline under fonctoriellement is substantially shorter than the word. Its actual endpoints are reported separately from the nominal letter-span alternatives, so the uncertainty is not disguised as an intention to underline the entire word. The ordinary NB underline is unambiguous.

The short dash after épimorphisme is retained as a short source dash. The lowercase p signs, the word si, singular construction and source high quote pairs are reported separately from H’s substitutions. C’s doubts in évidente, épimorphisme, the inline relation, cancelled index and argument opening remain because the crop does not settle all relevant strokes; the injectif doubt is removed.
